name: context-recall-benchmark-dataset
description: A benchmark that measures a model's ability to recall information presented earlier in a provided context window: given long contexts containing facts or passages, models are queried to reproduce or answer questions about earlier content. It evaluates memory/recall performance across varying context lengths and content types.
evaluation_method: exact_match (and/or token-level F1 for partial matches)
reputation: A niche, research-oriented dataset hosted on Hugging Face used for probing context-memory/recall capabilities of language models; limited but growing use in long-context evaluation work.
